deploy-bot: STARTING deployment to prod (change-window 2026-03-20 23:00-01:00 UTC). Trigger: @helen. Tag: release/v2.4.1. Commits:
 • 7a1b2c3 - PR #842 - fix(kv-cache): handle empty prefix - helen - https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/7a1b2c3
 • d4e5f6a - PR #843 - runtime: avoid double free in batching - samir - https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/d4e5f6a
 • c12d34e - PR #839 - docs: release notes - devin - https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/c12d34e
Safe pin: model-bert-q8/v1.2
Deploy ID: prod-deploy-1798765432

helen: starting smoke tests now, will update in ~5m. @devin can you watch metrics?

devin: looking. observability dashboards: https://kibana.redwood/prod/dashboards/123 — baseline OK so far :thumbsup:

samir: note I've requested pin of runtime image to sha 0b9f2a. If latency spikes, auto-fallback rule -> release/v2.4.0.

molly: deploy status: 2/3 services applied. model-serving failed to apply migration on one instance, error in logs -> rolling back model-serving only.

deploy-bot: UPDATE: model-serving failed applying DB migration on instance gs-12. Error: "duplicate key value violates unique constraint". Rolling back model-serving to commit 6f5e4d3 (pre-deploy). Rollback initiated by deploy-bot. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/model-serving-migration

helen: thanks — good call. Please pin model-serving to release/v2.4.0 until migration is validated in staging. I'll open a postmortem and assign owners.

deploy-bot: FINISHED prod-deploy-1798765432 — STATUS: partial_success (model-serving rolled back). Summary:
 - applied: api-gateway (7a1b2c3), runtime (d4e5f6a)
 - rolled back: model-serving -> 6f5e4d3
Actions: create postmortem, replay migration in staging with uniqueness checks, and re-run canary. Links: https://ci.redwood/builds/1798765432, https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/6f5e4d3...d4e5f6a

samir: I'll coordinate a staging migration run and add extra checks to the migration script.

helen: acknowledged. Will circulate release notes update and hold on further prod releases until migration issue is closed.
